I see all these people advertising qualifications for painters with no experience in 3 months, I've looked into many and they haven't got any credibility . There's only 1 real paper qualification for painters thats an apprenticeship, there's always been painters that haven't done apprenticeships , known as cowboys, but they were a minority, it seems they are now the majority.
